page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.16xlarge is a compute-focused x86_64 instance featuring 64 vCPUs across 32 physical Intel Xeon 8163 cores operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU for a total memory capacity of 64.0 GB. Built on KVM hypervisor architecture, this server includes 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, zero local SSD storage, and no GPU accelerators. The CPU instruction set includes AVX, AVX-512 (F and VNNI), AES, FMA, and BMI2 capabilities.

Performance data indicates a distinct trade-off between single-threaded execution and parallel multi-core performance. Single-core benchmarks yield lower relative results, including a Geekbench single-core score of 1022.0 and a single-threaded gzip compression speed of 19.05 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded throughput is stronger, evidenced by a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 205.34 GB/sec and a multi-core stress-ng score of 47218.85. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 119.27 GB/sec, while static web serving throughput measures 30.13 GB/sec.

The 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to RAM gigabytes provides high core density for tasks that are not constrained by memory capacity. This hardware layout offers qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallel compute workloads. The instance fits tasks such as software compilation, batch processing, parallel data compression, web serving, and concurrent execution pipelines.
